sourceOfTruth: /Librarium records, evidence, assertions, manifests, and tools are canonical; /Data artifacts are generated runtime output and are not edited manually.
runtimePolicy: Runtime consumes generated /Data only. The client is read-only for gameplay state.
guardianEngineeringPolicy: Guardian Hall engineering phases 1-10 use isolated workspaces and independent persisted controls for planning, engineering, build, validation, runtime/gameplay testing, optimization, documentation, candidate ZIPs, repository updates, and overnight execution. Candidate ZIP generation defaults true; autonomous and repository-update capabilities default false, and Repository Updates must never be enabled on the user's behalf.
updatePolicy: Codex updates the local repository unless the user explicitly asks Codex to commit/push. GitHub Actions is the pushed verification gate.
modePolicy: Each assistant must identify mode first. Codex updates local repository state. ChatGPT uses verified patch ZIPs for local application unless explicitly instructed otherwise.
neverGuessPolicy: Never guess when creating, fixing, reviewing, packaging, or reporting updates. Verify before claiming success; if something cannot be verified, state that clearly.
referenceDataPolicy: All WCC data, WCC-labeled data, WSGSERVE-related data, imported archives, website data, and community/tool data are reference-only unless the user explicitly approves a reviewed import or reconciliation update.
